## New
- **Setup assistant:** the first start now asks one thing after another: language and your name, look (design, light or dark, your colour), the music you like, your favourite artists (you follow them right away), where your music comes from, and how you listen (autoplay, search, visualizer, sound). At the end you pick how to start
- **More suggestions on the start page:** single songs for you, whole playlists for you and artists for you, made from the artists you listen to and follow
- **Like every song:** songs from Spotify, YouTube and the catalog can be liked too. They land in Liked songs, and the heart is always there in the small and the big player and in the song menu
- **Long press anywhere on a song:** song cards on the start page, the quick tiles, the small player and the big cover open the menu

## Fixed
- **Skipping starts at once:** the beginning of the next songs is fetched ahead of time, so a skip plays without loading
- **Bluetooth names in full:** the name of your headphones is no longer cut off in the big player, the small player and the device list (Android asks once for the Bluetooth permission to read the full name)
- **Pull to refresh:** works reliably and looks like reloading a web page: round arrow, the page dims and the new one fades in
- **Small player:** as wide as the tab bar, tapping the artist opens the big player (artists are links in the big player), progress line fixed in Liquid Glass
- **Big player:** slides down when closed with the arrow, no extra volume slider, buttons no longer stay lit after a tap
- **Tab bar:** the blob no longer disappears on album, artist and playlist pages
- **Start page:** the pressed card is highlighted around cover and text
- **Computer:** thicker progress line that is easier to grab, a bit higher in the player bar, and in the big player only as wide as the cover and title

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
